CFML Language Reference: Functions

ListValueCountNoCase

Returns the number of elements in a list that are equal to the given value, without regard to upper or lower case.

Category

List functions

Syntax

ListValueCountNoCase(list, value [, delimiters ])

Parameters

list
The list to search.
value
The value to count.
delimiters
Optional. The delimiter characters of the list; the default is a comma.

Returns

The number of matching elements; 0 if there are none.

Usage

Useful for tallying free-form input such as survey answers, where visitors type "Yes", "yes" and "YES". ListValueCount is the case-sensitive version.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Votes = "Yes yes NO maybe YES no Yes y2k">
<CFOUTPUT>
<P>Votes: #Votes#</P>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>Answer</TH><TH>ListValueCount</TH><TH>ListValueCountNoCase</TH></TR>
<TR><TD>yes</TD><TD>#ListValueCount(Votes, "yes", " ")#</TD><TD>#ListValueCountNoCase(Votes, "yes", " ")#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>no</TD><TD>#ListValueCount(Votes, "no", " ")#</TD><TD>#ListValueCountNoCase(Votes, "no", " ")#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>maybe</TD><TD>#ListValueCount(Votes, "maybe", " ")#</TD><TD>#ListValueCountNoCase(Votes, "maybe", " ")#</TD></TR>
</TABLE>
</CFOUTPUT>

See also

ListValueCount, ListFindNoCase, ListContainsNoCase
